verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly define the SKILL.md format (name + description frontmatter, directory with optional scripts/references) and describe a guided `@plugin-creator`/skill-creator flow that asks what the skill does, when it triggers, and whether to include scripts — enabling authoring from a documented template rather than reverse-engineering. Community evidence corroborates developers building their own skills this way. Missing for 10: a full worked SKILL.md example/template file shown verbatim and independent hands-on verification of the authoring flow.
